About S3

Your Local Partner for Global Technology.

Strategic Security Systems is an Uzbekistan-based systems integrator focused on advanced communications, observation, software and security-related technologies.

Our role

The bridge between global technology and local needs.

We work with international technology providers to identify suitable solutions, coordinate technical integration and support implementation in line with customer requirements.

We bring together technology providers, customers and technical expertise to help organizations access, implement and sustain advanced capabilities.

Successful adoption involves more than equipment delivery. It also requires practical knowledge, technical support and cooperation with local specialists.

Our long-term ambition is to contribute to sustainable technical capability in Uzbekistan through responsible international cooperation and systems integration.
